entries.en: Package received. Thank you, V. Keep up the good work. The streets will remember your name.
entries.ro: Pachet primit. Mulțumesc, V. Continuă tot așa. Străzile o să-ți țină minte numele.

entries.en: Excellent. Equilibrium sometimes demands sacrifices. Contract closed.
entries.ro: Excelent. Echilibrul cere uneori sacrificii. Contract închis.
